London Healthcare Insights

Pro-bono consulting for healthcare and life sciences organisations. Led by students from universities across the UK.

£0 consulting feesBased in London · Healthcare focused
A different perspective on healthcare

What is LHI?

LHI gives students practical experience in healthcare consulting while providing organisations with research and commercial analysis at no cost.

Consulting

Scoped projects for healthcare and life sciences organisations.

Market analysis

A monthly overview of pharmaceutical sector developments.

Events

Firm visits, industry discussions, and case workshops.

Project format

How a project works

A project manager leads a team of 3–5 consultants. An LHI client executive supports the engagement, with the client providing context and feedback throughout.

5–8weeks per project
~5hours per student, per week
£0consulting fees
Discuss a project ↗

The project team

Client contact + LHI support

Client

Brief, context and feedback

1 project manager

Leads research and day-to-day client contact

1 LHI client executive

Supports the team and the engagement

3–5 consultants

Research, analysis, and deliverables

The project manager coordinates the team’s work and client updates.

01
At the start

Agree the scope

Meet the team, share company materials, and agree the research questions and deliverables.

02
During the project

Research and checkpoints

Develop the analysis and review progress with the client, adjusting the work where needed.

03
At completion

Present the findings

Deliver the agreed outputs, discuss the findings and receive client feedback.

Market analysis

Market Monitor

This monthly, student-produced publication tracks drug approvals, regulatory changes, stock moves, clinical trials, M&A activity, and other developments across healthcare and life sciences. Published since January 2024, it helps build commercial awareness and supports interview preparation.
